partnershipPlan: Two members of the citizens' health panel review the review questions and the plain-language summary; the local pharmaceutical committee and the out-of-hours GP provider comment on the joint display before it goes to the board.
socialListening: No social media listening; public comments submitted to the authority's consultation on pharmacy services in the last two years are read for mentions of late opening.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I finish at nine; if the pharmacy shuts at six I either wait until my day off or go to the hospital.
items.implication: Extract evidence on shift workers and weekday evening use.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: After half past nine it is just me and a locked door, and the only customers are the ones I worry about.
items.implication: Treat lone working and security as outcomes in the practice strand.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Every business case says the service pays for itself, and none of them measured what people would have done otherwise.
items.implication: Show budget figures across counterfactual assumptions.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Our Sunday calls did not drop; the pharmacy took people who would have waited until Monday.
items.implication: Keep displacement as a balancing outcome.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I am not registered anywhere since I moved, so the pharmacy is the only place that will look at me without an appointment.
items.implication: Extract registration status of users where reported.

summary: Five composite voices on late access, lone working, counted savings, displacement and people without a GP.
